test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Has the ban been lifted by the Defence Ministry?

options.text: Has the Defence Ministry lifted the ban?
Has the Defence Ministry been lifted the ban?
Is the ban being lifted by the Defence Ministry?
Did the Defence Ministry have lifted the ban?

solution:
The correct answer is '**Has the Defence Ministry lifted the ban?**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the **Passive Voice** and we have to change it into Active Voice&l
